title: Back Where It Began: Montana Broker Returns to REMAX to Launch His Own Brokerage
summary: After starting his career at REMAX, DJ Smith comes back to the network that shaped his journey.
body_markdown:
DJ Smith is returning to his REMAX roots and adding a new title to his resume: Broker/Owner of REMAX Confluence.


When Smith entered the industry in 2014, he joined REMAX All Stars in Missoula, where he was mentored by veteran broker John Herring for nearly five years. The experience left a lasting impression on him. More than a decade later, after building a successful career as an agent, managing broker and state association leader, Smith knew exactly where he wanted to launch his own brokerage: REMAX.


“The mentorship I received early in my career changed everything for me,” he says. “John saw potential in me, brought me under his wing and taught me what he knew. A big part of why I wanted to become a Broker/Owner is because I want to provide that same experience for the next generation of agents.”


That passion for helping others grow became a defining theme throughout Smith’s career. While he enjoyed selling real estate, he found even greater fulfillment in developing people, mentoring agents and helping them navigate the profession’s biggest challenges and opportunities.


His commitment to service extended beyond the brokerage walls, eventually leading him to serve as president of both the Missoula Organization of REALTORS® in 2020 and the Montana Association of REALTORS® in 2024.


## Smith Family


DJ Smith and Karalie Smith, Broker/Owners of REMAX Confluence


**A brand built for growth**


Smith left REMAX All Stars around 2019 with a foundation of skills and a passion for the industry. He eventually worked at other brands, deepening his leadership ability. When he was ready to open his own brokerage, he thoroughly evaluated his options and his research reinforced something he had learned early in his career: the REMAX model stands apart.


“What I’ve always seen with REMAX is that the local culture and the national culture align,” he says. “That’s momentum you can build on.”


Smith also values the franchise-first approach that enables Broker/Owners to feel fully supported by the brand.


“The franchise model makes you feel equipped to step in and know you have the whole brand behind you,” he says. “You’re not out there on an island by yourself.”


He is also excited about REMAX being under the umbrella of Real REMAX Group, viewing it as an opportunity to strengthen the technology and resources available to affiliates while preserving the entrepreneurial spirit that has long attracted ambitious real estate professionals to the network.


As REMAX Confluence opens its doors in Missoula, Smith’s vision extends well beyond transaction volume or market share.


His focus is on building a values-based organization where agents support one another, learn from one another and have access to the mentorship needed to reach their goals. He expects the office to grow quickly, with plans to expand throughout Missoula and potentially into other Montana markets over time.


As he works to build the next generation of Montana real estate professionals, Smith is doing it with the same network, culture and spirit of mentorship that first inspired him more than a decade ago.


Written by **REMAX News**
